adaptations: Source-port QKVParallelLinear, ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear, LinearBase, UnquantizedLinearMethod and their parameter/weight-loader classes. Each RTP ViT worker uses disable_tp=True (replicated full encoder).
Retain RTP/HF configuration, parameter names and BaseModelOutputWithPooling envelope.
Retain RTP attention backend loader and restore SM103 BF16 equal-length dense FA4 with native Q/K/V72 and scale72; keep varlen for other shapes.
Copy default rotary cache, positional interpolation, patch GEMM, encoder and merger compute.
Remove vLLM engine/distributed/torch.compile decorators; preserve RTP exact-grid CUDA graph interface.
No preprocessing, scheduler, video decode, resize or token assembly changes.
Use int64 position-output and rotary batch/row offsets for packed B32 tensors exceeding 2**31 elements.
Swap rotary sequence/head launch axes so B32 sequence tiles do not exceed CUDA grid.y=65535.
Retain RTP large-row LayerNorm guard: this host Torch 2.11 native LayerNorm returns incorrect tail rows at 7,383,552 x 1152. Each normalized row still uses native nn.LayerNorm.

Port PluggableLayer registry, QuantizeMethodBase, shard utilities and default CUDA F.linear GEMM; replace engine global TP state with the worker-local rank 0 / size 1, and reject unavailable collectives.
Omit TPU loader synchronization and CPU-specific weight packing. CPU uses PyTorch F.linear. VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 is explicitly rejected because its kernel is not ported.

Keep the quant_method factory dispatch and shard-aware loaders. This Qwen3.5 model currently accepts unquantized ViT weights only; quantized ViT kernels and engine QuantizationConfig implementations are not ported.

Bridge RTP visual-relative complete checkpoint dictionaries to each vLLM parameter weight_loader, followed by process_weights_after_loading and update_param_tp_status. Preserve the HF load_state_dict interface for ordinary state dict copies.
Read the strided Q/K view directly in rotary_kernel; remove pre-RoPE contiguous and preserve the native head dimension without zero padding.

Consolidate the active encoder into qwen3_5_moe_vit.py under the original Qwen3_5MoeVision* class names. Shared linear helpers use vision_* modules and the rotary kernel lives in vision_kernels.py; remove the previous duplicate encoder and rotary implementation.

Add packed Q/K RoPE for H16/D72 BF16/FP16 with matching rotary-factor dtype: share cos/sin within each program, avoid half-head tile padding and write contiguous Q/K outputs directly. Retain the general kernel for other layouts, dtypes and modes; keep native LayerNorm and GELU.

Fuse unquantized FP16/BF16 CUDA inference FC1 bias and tanh GELU with torch._addmm_activation; preserve CPU, other dtypes, quantization-method overrides and autograd paths. The fused epilogue omits intermediate FC1 rounding, so embeddings are not bitwise equivalent to separate GEMM/GELU.
